thread:
emily: Heads-up: we've got a chunk of spans missing for requests that flow gateway -> SQS -> worker. Traces show the gateway span, then worker spans with a different trace id (looks orphaned). Anyone seen this?
ben: Saw a few anomalies last week but didn't dig in. Can you share a repro or sample trace ids?
emily: Yep — repro is simple: hit /v1/generate with the async route, gateway enqueues to our queue, worker picks up. Example trace id where it breaks: 4f3a2... (linked to logs).
carla: Common culprit is propagation format/limits. Are we writing W3C traceparent/tracestate into SQS attributes or stuffing the full OTLP binary blob?
emily: We tried the 'binary' approach initially (injecting the full OTEL BinaryContext into a message attribute) since that preserved baggage, but it looks like attributes are being truncated / dropped on some retry paths. Snippet we used:```python
attrs = {
  'otel-bin': base64.b64encode(context_binary)
}
client.send_message(QueueUrl=q, MessageBody=body_json, MessageAttributes=attrs)
```
dan: SQS attributes + some connectors are... finicky. Between size, charset and connector transformations you can end up losing things. Also some retry/visibility flow re-enqueues without attributes. Might be safer to keep to the minimal W3C header (traceparent) and a small tracestate if needed.
ben: We need to preserve the sampled flag too. If sampling bit gets lost, spans become rootless in backends. We could just attach the canonical traceparent string as an attribute: "00-{traceid}-{spanid}-01" (or whatever the trace flags are). Small and resilient.
carla: Another operational gotcha: some legacy consumers (kinesis->lambda shim, DLQ processors) strip attributes entirely. I'd vote for a dual approach: set attribute + a small fallback field inside message body (e.g., body._rmeta.traceparent). That way older consumers still surface the id.
emily: I like attribute + body fallback, but changing body shape touches a lot of teams. Could we standardize on a CloudEvent extension too? e.g., ce-traceparent header — many connectors preserve CloudEvent extensions.
ben: For rollout simplicity: gateway lib should inject: 1) MessageAttribute 'traceparent' (string), 2) If tracestate present and short, add 'tracestate' attr, 3) Add body._rmeta.traceparent as fallback (optional, opt-in). Worker lib should prefer attrs then fallback to body.
infra-bot: queue-monitor: note that some transports (SQS, SNS) have per-attribute size/charset restrictions and some middleware (connectors) rewrite attributes. Recommend testing max length per attribute and total attr count in your region.
dan: Also think about encoding: hex vs base64 vs urlsafe. Keep it short: traceparent is already compact. If we ever need baggage, consider a separate store (metadata table) keyed by trace id to avoid blowing message attributes.
carla: tracestate is trickier — it grows. We should preserve it when small (<~1KB?) otherwise trim vendor entries or snapshot to a metadata table with a short key in the message.
emily: Rollout plan proposal:
  - PoC lib in gateway to inject traceparent attr + body fallback (ben + carla)
  - Update worker lib to extract attribute then fallback to body (runtime/ML workers)
  - Add end-to-end test that simulates DLQ/requeue and verifies trace continuity
  - Canary for a week, monitor orphaned-span rate and sampling flags
Can we get owners?
ben: I'll prototype the gateway injector (go + node bindings). ETA EOW for a simple patch. Will add a small test harness that injects corrupted attrs to simulate drops.
carla: I'll update the worker SDK extraction and add the body-fallback parsing. Will also draft the RFC for tracestate trimming rules.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: telemetry/propagate-trace-attrs (PR #3142)
ben: Quick note: avoid blowing up message size. Keep attr usage tiny. If you need to attach large baggage, use key->store pattern.
emily: Agreed. After PoC we should add a telemetry check in console dashboards: percent of requests with contiguous trace across gateway->queue->worker (baseline + alert).
carla: Also let's add a small flag in the exporter: if worker sees no parent but body contains a fallback traceparent, mark span as "remote_parent_from_body" in attributes so we can debug in traces.
emily: Perfect — once Ben & Carla have PoC we can do a canary and add the dashboard metric. Please post PoC links here when ready and I'll add owners to the RFC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
